meta.refresh: Every four hours requested; source publication and GitHub delays apply.
meta.scope: Selected free public sources. Missing/paid sources are not substituted with estimates.

indicators.name: IBIT bitcoin holdings
indicators.note: Fund bitcoins are not net flows. AUM changes include price effects.

indicators.name: GLD gold holdings
indicators.note: Tonnes held are a demand proxy; changes are not dollar net flows. Price and holdings can diverge.
indicators.error: ValueError: Issuer returned a custodian bar-list PDF, not comparable full-fund holdings CSV

indicators.name: BTC perpetual funding
indicators.note: Deribit BTC-PERPETUAL only; 8-hour funding is not annualised. Positive funding is not a directional forecast.

indicators.name: BTC perpetual open interest
indicators.note: USD notional can rise from price changes. One exchange does not measure all leverage.

indicators.name: Bitcoin implied volatility
indicators.note: Deribit DVOL is annualised implied volatility, not a price direction or an observed future outcome.

indicators.name: Bitcoin active addresses
indicators.note: Coin Metrics community coverage. Addresses are not distinct people.

indicators.name: Bitcoin transactions
indicators.note: Transactions include exchange and self transfers; not a direct adoption or valuation measure.

indicators.name: Bitcoin network fees
indicators.note: BTC per day; fee changes can reflect congestion, not just demand.

indicators.name: Bitcoin estimated hash rate
indicators.note: Estimated network security input, not a price target.

indicators.name: US M2 growth
indicators.note: Year-over-year US money growth; publication lags and revisions apply. Correlation is not causation.

indicators.name: Broad trade-weighted US dollar
indicators.note: 20-observation percentage change, not a DXY futures quote.

indicators.name: Gold managed-money net futures
indicators.note: COMEX gold futures-only managed-money longs minus shorts. Weekly positions are released with a lag; categories are not one unified institution.

directory.name: World Gold Council · Gold Demand Trends
directory.status: Source directory · manual research; no licensed automatic series connected
directory.note: Quarterly central-bank purchases, bars/coins, jewellery, mine supply and recycling. Do not substitute a gold-price move for physical demand.

directory.name: Deribit option skew / term structure
directory.note: DVOL is connected separately. A comparable 25-delta risk reversal needs matched expiries/deltas and historical quotes; DVOL is not skew.

directory.name: Canada local purchasing power
directory.status: Not connected · current return tools remain USD / US CPI
directory.note: CAD returns require date-aligned USD/CAD and Canadian CPI. Currency conversion alone is not Canadian purchasing power.
